label: Test rational governance and the end versus policy requirement
summary: Distinct continuation of #1962 and #1963. See docs/notes/will-versus-chance.md#end-requirement-policy-requirement-and-productive-fixity-2026-11-25. Analyst argument using the existing Optimal greatest-value definition: if every feasible complete output omitting d has a strictly better feasible competitor, each optimal output contains d; conversely, given an optimum, a common recipient of all optima satisfies that strict-improvement condition. A world-level optimizer can therefore be fixed toward d even when other recipients vary. Rational exercise and absence of end requirement are separate conditions for a WN counterinstance; selective diffusion additionally requires two-way giving toward some being. Reproduced tied-optimum structural example and 6,561 finite ordinal quality assignments in Python; 1,055 satisfy the improvement condition, all pass. Distinguish attainment of the source's own end, antecedent normative policy, and actual accessible exercise. Due-perfection obligations conditional on an adopted creative end can give a positive nonmaximizing policy, but do not establish actual accessible omission. Equal productive and contrastive coverage credited to objective good-sensitive impersonal sources. Actual apprehended content governing this same productive exercise provides intentional explanatory content not licensed by output conformity, one power or subject identity alone. Strict simplicity excludes the intellectual-but-blind rival only if its selective role requires a really distinct intrinsic principle; this application remains open. Root-attribute and NAR connections explicitly preserve existing holder, rational-power, WN/SS and grounding bridges. No new proof edge or source claim; no claim of novel formal consequence or actual metaphysical countermodel. Author self-sweep completed for prose; full local convention and CLI checks unavailable; independent semantic challenge pending.
blocker: Reopen with a warranted intrinsic-constitution criterion for formative relevance (or a positive simple-source intellectual-but-blind account); an independently justified complete-decision permission or obligation covering omission and competing goods; and actual accessible exercise omitting the non-end-required recipient. Preserve actual existential supply and recipient-directed reference. No premise discharge.
